Name: Rename
Author: CoinzReturns
Description:
[b]READ 1.1.0 changes for this mod 
Please be aware that file version 1.1.0 of this mod is the most stable, it will work with the same stardew valley version as the last version
of this mod
I fixed a big bug with the previous version of this mod and I'll keep the older version up for history sake but you should use the current stable version as it
has less bugs and issues with renaming yourself. Thank you.[/b]
[b]LASTLY please do [i]not [/i]use a save where your [/b][b][quote][u]character's name has spaces[/u].[/quote][/b]

[b]Spaces are used as a seperation character and [/b][i]adding spaces to your name makes it impossible to rename yourself back to your old name again [/i][b]on new files.
[/b][u]Additionally you may not want to try this on any save files that have characters with spaces in their names unless you want copies of them renamed whatever you pick.[/u]
[b]YOU WILL not lose any save data though you will just create a new copy of your old save, with a name you might not have wanted to keep.[/b]

All this mod does is allow you to use the .setname command  in chat.
For some reason I couldn't use '/' as a leading character.
Anyways, basically it lets you rename your character in game.
I have not tested this on multiplayer, please report multiplayer bugs if you find any.
Thank you.
Please enjoy this mod.

[b]
[/b]
(Little tip)
Change your name to an item code like [129] if you want to cheat and then talk to an npc that says your name.
Or to the legend fish [163]

This mod will allow you to change your name as a joke, or to change it permanently to anything.
Or, it will allow you to change your name to an item, get those items then change your name back.
(Shh no one has to know you did that). ;)
I hope you enjoy the mod, if you have any questions feel free to direct message me I'll try to respond.
Also I won't downgrade this to non beta right now I'm sorry, but I may in the near future if there's enough demand.
This is my very first mod so I'm not very savvy at this yet, please keep in mind I'm not an expert modder.

Downloads.Description:
This mod lets you rename your player character and apparently save in game. I didn't know that when changing Game1.player.Name but yes it works.
You can also use it to change your name to an item code like the Legend then change back before saving.

Manifest.Name: Rename
Manifest.Description: This is my first mod. It lets you rename yourself during game. If you name yourself something new and save then expect a new save file. If you name yourself back then save, expect over writing the old save file. I reccomend backing up your saves just in case before using this mod. Thanks.
Manifest.Author: Remmie

Downloads.Description:
Changes: Fixed a bug involving "Unnamed Farmhand" text posted in chat when your name was blank or incorrect causing you to be unable to change your name ever again due to an extra space in the user's name.
Use this mod to change your name in game.
